gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathology diagnosis of glioblastoma, or variants such as gliosarcoma, on initial and/or reresection by 2021 WHO glioblastoma criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: Proton radiotherapy and bevacizumab (Avastin) are used to minimize the possible side effects of this approach.
Participants will also receive Bevacizumab per standard of care, at treating physician's discretion.

arms: Cohort A: sMRI-Guided RT at 35 Gy in 10 fractions
Cohort B: sMRI-Guided RT at 40 Gy in 10 fractions

coder_notes: Registered phase NA (fails S3) but coded in full. The investigational question is sMRI-guided dose-escalated proton radiotherapy. Bevacizumab is given per standard of care in both arms with the stated purpose of minimising side effects; coded supportive (rule 2); soc_backbone (rule 3) would be the alternative. Either way no candidate agent. Both arms experimental, neither acts as control. Spectroscopic MRI is imaging, not a molecular biomarker.
